FX-BOIL-001.says: New seed every 2 frames, amount 30, size 8, speed 0 (a push of 2.4 pixels at most): frames 0 and 1 are FX-TURB-AE-007 (seed 0), frames 2 and 3 the same warp with seed 1, frame 4 seed 2: the stripes jump to a new wobble every second frame and hold still between, the hand-drawn boil.

FX-BOIL-002.says: New seed every 0, written: one seed for ever, so every frame is FX-TURB-AE-007.

FX-BOIL-003.says: New seed every 1: a new seed on every frame, frame f drawn with seed f.

FX-BOIL-004.says: New seed every 3 from seed 8: frames 0 to 2 seed 8, frames 3 and 4 seed 9.

FX-BOIL-005.says: New seed every 2.9: the whole part, 2, is counted, so this is FX-BOIL-001.

FX-BOIL-006.says: New seed every 2 with speed 20: the evolution still moves every frame, so no two frames are alike, and frames 2 and 3 use seed 1.

FX-BOIL-007.says: New seed every keyed from 1 at frame 0 to 4 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 seed 0; at frame 2 the setting is 2.5, whole part 2, step 1; at frame 4 it is 4, step 1.

FX-BOIL-008.says: New seed every 2 in a file without units (D-127's classic push), amount 3, size 8, speed 0: FX-TURB-004's warp on frames 0 and 1, seed 1 on frames 2 and 3.

FX-BOIL-009.says: FX-BOIL-001 moved three pixels right: the layer grows by 3, so the three columns left of the drawing show the stripes pushed into them, and the boil is the same, moved.

FX-BOIL-010.says: FX-BOIL-001 with edges repeat: nothing grows, a push past the edge reads the nearest edge pixel; the seed steps as before.

FX-BOIL-011.says: New seed every -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BOIL-012.says: New seed every 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BOIL-013.says: New seed every keyed from 2 at frame 0 to 150 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
